visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens from a first-person perspective on a bed, looking through a large rectangular window at a breathtaking landscape of the Azusa River and the Hotaka Mountains under a bright, sunny sky with soft clouds. (2) The view shifts to an outdoor wide shot of the rocky riverbank where a few small figures of people are walking along the shallow, clear turquoise water surrounded by lush green forests and steep mountains. (3) The perspective changes to entering a modern, upscale hotel room featuring light wood accents, a small kitchenette area on the left, and a hallway leading toward two twin beds and a large scenic window at the far end. (4) A close-up pan follows the interior of the room, highlighting the tatami-style flooring, white-clothed beds with brown runners, and a dark purple sofa bed placed against the wall beneath the window. (5) The camera focuses on a dinner menu card from 'RESTAURANT LA BELLE FORET' listing French cuisine courses, followed by a montage of plated dishes: a salmon and avocado tartare, a creamy green soup, a pan-seared white fish with greens, and a rare-cooked steak. (6) A young man with glasses and a grey shirt is shown sitting in the restaurant, using a fork and knife to enjoy the steak dish. (7) The scene transitions to a bright morning by the river, followed by a shot of an outdoor breakfast setting featuring Eggs Benedict and a fresh salad served on a wooden tray with mountain views in the background. (8) The final shots show a dark wooden sign for 'KAMIKOCHI HOTEL SHIRAKABASO' and a wide view of the iconic Kappa Bridge spanning the river with mountains towering behind it.
